title: ESPM Configuration File Schema
description: Schema for the ESPM package manager configuration file

name.description: The name of the package. Should be scoped.

version.description: The version of the package following semver.

description.description: A short description of the package

exports.description: Map of export paths to their corresponding file paths

oneOf.description: The path to the main module
A map of package exports to files

include.description: List of files, directories or globs to include in the published package

exclude.description: List of files, directories or globs to exclude from the published package

import_map.description: Import map configuration for production dependencies

imports.description: Map of module specifiers to their URLs

^.*$.description: URL or specifier for the package

import_map_dev.description: Import map configuration for development dependencies

imports.description: Map of module specifiers to their URLs for development

^.*$.description: URL or specifier for the development package

espm_version.description: Version of the ESPM package manager used to create this configuration
